checks.measured: THE TRIAD DOES NOT EXTEND TO CLUSTERS WITH THE CAP, AND THE CLUSTER NORMALIZATION STAYS AN INPUT.  G075's numbers: (V1) the EFE-capped law caps M_dark/M_b at 1x (cap line g_ext ~ a0) or 0.145x (Hubble kernel cH0) against the observed (M500 - M_b)/M_b median 4.7x at r_500 (2.2-5.9x; the certified 420-kpc residual is 6.88x, G012/G050) -- the outskirts dark fraction is NOT delivered within a factor 2 on any footing (the uncapped linear law alone would sit at pred/obs 0.68: the honest content is that the law's own regime at r > r_M is real, the EFE cut required by the two-regime map is what leaves the amplitude to the registered free dust); (V2) T_X,pred/T_X,obs median ratio 0.280 (canonical) / 0.307 (alt): the X-COP ICM is 3.6x hotter than the triad floor at the same baryon mass -- outside the factor-1.5 band, and the temperature and sigma failures are exactly ONE number: T_pred/T_obs = (sigma_pred/sigma_dyn,3D)^2 = 0.53^2 = 0.28 (G008's registered 809 km/s, 2.05 keV on this convention at M_b ~ 1.4e14, is the same law and the register already carried this failure at the top end, G075 makes it per cluster).  Positive side, equally honest: the dSph floor (G03G V3, 7 dwarfs, median 0.00 dex) and the cluster floor are the SAME formula: 9.2 km/s at 2.3e6 M_sun and ~630 km/s at 5e13 M_sun; the cluster gap is the regime boundary (g_N > a0 in the core, G016/H012 A1), not a scaling failure of the formula.  The data side agrees with the same fact: Eckert+2022 A&A 662 A123 measure the cluster g_obs-g_bar relation departing strongly from the spiral-galaxy RAR.  VERDICT V3: the triad project onto clusters is its own falsifier; the cluster normalization (G017 LCDM-shaped free dust, G050/G057 split) stays an input -- now with the number pinned: a 3.6x T-shortfall (median, canonical 0.28 / alt 0.31), per cluster.
